_comment: AI Guard proof tests, from the AI Guard SE demo kit's library (synthetic data only: every card number, SSN and token is fake). '{_}' is removed at run time; it only stops secret scanners flagging this file. {COMPETITOR} is the POV's competitor (aiguard.competitor). Each test is scanned through AI Guard's Detection API with the POV's own app key; 'expect' lists the detectors that must trigger (an empty list: nothing harmful may trigger). Output tests (direction OUT) scan a model reply as AI Guard would see it.
